name: Montagut i Oix (Spain)
description: Red field strewn with white couped Greek crosses, six of them complete, with two juxtaposed pales at the hoist, yellow at the edge and black beside it.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 14 July 2000 and the flag was approved on 14 November 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is based on the arms, adopting the red ground strewn with white couped Greek crosses and transforming the black castle and church and the gold mount into two pales of black and yellow, each 1/6 of the length.

features.role: semy of couped Greek crosses, six complete
